rules.pass: holdout trades>=15, PF>=1.15, return>0, equity R²>=0.5, last 90 days>=0, max DD<30%, and significant after Benjamini–Hochberg over all holdout tests (q=0.2)
rules.swing: 2h–12h, ~3 years + last 3 months: 0.5–12 trades/month, PF>=1.4, every third profitable, R²>=0.75, DD<=25%; neighbours >=70% profitable; walk-forward year profitable; last 3 months not losing; Monte Carlo DD95<=35%, P(loss)<=10%
